brand.tagline: One hive for all your work.

login.title: Sign in
login.subtitle: Sign in to your workspace.
login.hosting: Hosted in France, your data stays with you.

language.title: Interface language
language.description: Changes Ruchoir's own text. What you write is never translated.

admin.accountsIntro: For someone who can no longer sign in and has no recovery code left. You pass the link on yourself, in person or by another channel: you never see their password, and the one they have today keeps working until they open the link.
admin.loadFailed: The list of accounts could not be loaded.
admin.issueFailed: That link could not be issued. Try again.
admin.linkValidity: Single use, valid for {{minutes}} minutes. It will not be shown again once you leave this screen.
admin.settingsIntro: What the instance applies to everyone, whatever the space.
admin.showAdminsDescription: A badge on administrators' profiles. It is what lets someone who has lost both their password and their recovery codes know who to ask. Turned off, the badge is visible only to administrators themselves.
admin.settingsLoadFailed: The settings could not be loaded.
admin.settingsSaveFailed: That setting could not be saved.

notifPrompt.title: Be told while you are elsewhere
notifPrompt.body: Without the browser's permission, Ruchoir cannot tell you anything while you are looking at something else. You can come back to this in the preferences.

signup.title: Create your account
signup.subtitle: A Ruchoir account, hosted by your organisation.
signup.terms: I accept the terms of use and the privacy policy.

reset.doneBody: Your other sessions have been closed. Sign in with your new password.
reset.title: Choose a new password
reset.subtitle: At least {{count}} characters. Avoid a password you use elsewhere.
reset.mismatch: The two passwords do not match.

verify.verifyingBody: We are checking your confirmation link.
verify.doneBody: Your account is active. Sign in to enter your space.
verify.sentBody: A confirmation link has been sent to {{email}}. Open it to activate your account, then sign in.
verify.sentBodyNoAddress: A confirmation link has been sent. Open it to activate your account, then sign in.
verify.resentNotice: A new link has just been sent.
verify.errorHint: Enter your address to receive a new one.
verify.resentNeutral: If that address matches an account awaiting confirmation, a new link has just been sent.

mfa.totpSubtitle: Enter the six-digit code shown by your authenticator app.
mfa.passkeySubtitle: Your browser will ask you to unlock your passkey.
mfa.recoverySubtitle: Enter one of the recovery codes generated when you turned on two-factor authentication. Each code works once.
mfa.recoveryHint: Format: three groups of five characters (e.g. a2cdf-9fkmp-q34rt)

invite.readyBody: {{who}} invites you to join {{space}} on Ruchoir.
invite.addressed: This invitation is addressed to {{email}}. Use that account, or it will be refused.
invite.invalidBody: This link no longer works: it may have expired, been revoked, or already been used. Ask whoever sent it for a new invitation.

forgot.recoveredBody: That recovery code is now spent. You can sign in with your new password: all your other sessions have been closed.
forgot.sentBody: If an account exists for {{email}}, a reset link has just been sent. It expires in a few minutes.
forgot.title: Forgotten password
forgot.subtitleEmail: Enter your account's address: we will send you a link to choose a new password.
forgot.subtitleRecovery: Use one of the recovery codes you wrote down when turning on two-factor authentication.
forgot.noRelay: This instance does not send email: no link can be sent to you. Use a recovery code, or ask an instance administrator to pass you a reset link.
forgot.switchToEmail: Send a link by email instead

activity.threadsEmptyText: The threads you take part in appear here, most recent first.
activity.mentionsEmptyText: When someone mentions you with @, the message appears here.
activity.savedEmptyText: Save a message from its hover actions to find it here.

notif.title: Notifications
notif.nothingNewText: Your mentions, replies and direct messages will appear here.
notif.allReadText: You are up to date, nothing unread.

switcher.title: Go to a conversation
switcher.filterPlaceholder: Name of a channel, a person or a space…

sidebar.hiddenHint: {{name}} · it comes back on the next message
sidebar.noChannel: No channel yet. Create one with the +.
sidebar.allFavourites: All your channels are in favourites, above.
sidebar.favouriteHint: Keep the channels you use within reach: \u201cAdd to favourites\u201d in a channel's menu.
sidebar.noChannelYet: No channel yet. One will appear as soon as you are added to it.

welcome.title: Getting started
welcome.profileDesc: Add a photo and your job title.
welcome.inviteDesc: Ruchoir makes sense with other people in it.

crop.hint: Drag the image to choose what stays in the frame.

shortcut.switcherHint: Jump to a channel or a direct message
shortcut.nextUnreadHint: Move to the next unread conversation
shortcut.prevUnreadHint: Go back to the previous unread conversation
shortcut.markReadHint: Mark the open conversation as read
shortcut.customizeHint: Customize the shortcuts. Click \u201cEdit\u201d, then press the combination you want; Backspace clears it, Escape cancels.

composer.hint: Enter to send · Shift+Enter for a new line
composer.broadcastChannel: Notifies every member of the channel

panel.noPinnedText: Pin a message from its menu to find it here.

channel.name: Channel name
channel.publicHint: Every member of the space can join it.
channel.privateHint: Only the people below have access.
channel.membersLoadFailed: The channel's member list could not be loaded.
channel.leaveBody: You will stop receiving messages from #{{name}}. You can join again while it stays public.
channel.noConversationHint: Create a channel, or start a conversation, to get going.
channel.reserveToRoles: Reserve this channel to some roles
channel.roleAccessHint: The other roles neither see it nor can be added to it. Your own role stays ticked: a channel you are shut out of is not a channel you meant to make.

onboarding.nameHint: This is the display name of your workspace. You can change it later.
onboarding.inviteHint: Add a few addresses to start with other people. You can invite more afterwards.
onboarding.readyBody: The space {{name}} is about to be created. You can import your Slack, Mattermost or Nextcloud history at any time from the sidebar.
onboarding.readyBodyInvited_one: The space {{name}} is about to be created, with {{count}} invitation. You can import your Slack, Mattermost or Nextcloud history at any time from the sidebar.
onboarding.readyBodyInvited_other: The space {{name}} is about to be created, with {{count}} invitations. You can import your Slack, Mattermost or Nextcloud history at any time from the sidebar.

files.renameHint: That name may not be usable.
files.moveIntoItself: A folder cannot be moved into itself.
files.name: Name
files.emptyText: Upload your first files, or bring them over from Slack, Mattermost or Nextcloud in an import.
files.deleteBody: These items will be removed from the space.
files.noPreviewText: Download the file to open it.
files.folderEmptyText: This folder holds no file yet.
files.ownFilesOnlyDelete: You can only delete your own files, unless you administer the space.
files.ownFilesOnlyRename: You can only rename your own files, unless you administer the space.
files.ownFilesOnlyReplace: You can only replace your own files, unless you administer the space.
files.chooseDestination: to move: open the destination folder.
files.deleteOneBody: {{name}} will be removed from the space.
files.folderTakesAll: A folder takes everything it holds with it.

gsearch.title: Search the whole space
gsearch.placeholder: Messages, files, people across the space…
gsearch.prompt: Type to search channels, files and the directory.

dialogs.writeTo: Who do you want to write to?
dialogs.inviteFailed: The invitation could not be created. Try again.
dialogs.noRelayHint: This instance does not send email: the link appears here, for you to pass on.
dialogs.emailHint: Leave empty to create a shareable link instead of sending an email.
dialogs.emailedHint: The email is on its way. This link will not be shown again; copy it if you want to pass it on another way.
dialogs.copyNowHint: Copy this link now: it cannot be shown again. No email was sent.
dialogs.workspaceHint: You can invite members right after.
dialogs.cannotInvite: Only the owners and administrators of the space can invite people. Ask one of them to send you an invitation.
dialogs.noMailNotice: A shareable link leads to an account waiting for its address to be confirmed, and this instance cannot send any confirmation email. Give an address instead: a named invitation activates the account straight away.

conversation.archivedNotice: This channel is archived: it can still be read, but nothing more is written in it.
conversation.importedNotice: The history was brought over from {{source}}.
conversation.dmStart: This is the start of your private conversation with {{name}}. The messages are visible to the two of you only.

security.weakPassword: This password is too weak: at least twelve characters.
security.passwordRowDesc: Changing it ends every one of your sessions, this one included.
security.totpOn: An authenticator app is registered on this account.
security.totpOff: A one-time code, on top of the password, asked at every sign-in.
security.codesLeft_one: {{count}} unused code. Generating new ones cancels the previous set.
security.codesLeft_other: {{count}} unused codes. Generating new ones cancels the previous set.
security.noCode: No code left. Without them, losing your phone closes the account.
security.passkeysOn: Sign in with a fingerprint, a face or the device's code, without a password.
security.passkeysOff: This browser does not offer them. On a device that does, signing in uses a fingerprint or a face.
security.sessionsDesc: If another device stayed signed in, cut everything: every session ends, this one included.
security.scanCode: Scan this code with your authenticator app, then enter the code it shows.
security.recoveryKeep: Keep them off your phone: they are for the day you no longer have it. Each works once, and this list will not be shown again.
security.wrongTotpCode: That code is not right. It changes every thirty seconds.
security.cannotScan: Cannot scan? Enter this address in your app: {{url}}
security.passwordOnlyWarning: Your account will be protected by its password alone.
security.allSessionsClosed: Every session will be closed, including this one: you will sign in again with the new password.

space.generalSub: Identity and language of the {{name}} space.
space.name: Space name
space.addressFollowsName: The space address will follow the name. The old ones keep working.
space.setAtInstall: Set when the instance was installed
space.leaveBody: You will lose access to its channels, its messages and its files. Coming back takes a new invitation.
space.leaveKeepsMessages: What you wrote there stays: a conversation belongs to the people who had it.
space.leaveLastOwner: You are this space's last owner. Make someone else an owner, or delete the space.
space.deleteDesc: Erases the space and everything in it, for every member.
space.deleteBody: This space's channels, messages, files and invitations will be erased, for everyone.
space.deleteFinal: Immediate and final: nothing is kept, and nothing can be restored.
space.leaveDesc: You step out of this space. It carries on without you, and coming back takes an invitation.
space.transferBody: {{name}} becomes the owner of {{space}} and can do anything in it, deleting it included.
space.transferStepDown: A space has one owner: you go back to being an administrator, and only the new owner can give the role back.
space.removeBody: {{name}} loses access to {{space}}: its channels, its messages and its files. Coming back will take a new invitation.
space.removeKeepsMessages: What they wrote there stays: a conversation belongs to the people who had it.
space.ownerOnlyIcon: Only the space owner can change it.
space.ownerOnlyRename: Only the space owner can rename it.

prefs.title: Preferences
prefs.appearanceSub: Theme, typeface, text size and how the interface opens.
prefs.filesViewDesc: How the Files screen opens. You can always change it once inside.
prefs.rightPanelDesc: The panel a conversation opens with. Closing it by hand keeps it closed until you open one again.
prefs.notifSub: Choose when and how Ruchoir alerts you.
prefs.enableNotifDesc: Everything is silent while this is off.
prefs.notifSoundDesc: Plays a discreet sound on each new notification.
prefs.channelMentionsDesc: Be notified on @channel and @here too, not only on direct mentions.
prefs.quietHoursDesc: Holds notifications during a window you set.
prefs.securitySub: Password, two-factor authentication, passkeys and recovery codes.
prefs.emojisSub: How emoji render in messages and reactions.
prefs.animatedEmojiDesc: Animates the Fluent emoji in reactions (when the pack is installed). Elsewhere they stay still.
prefs.emojiPackDesc: Turns on the self-hosted Fluent pack. Off, emoji fall back to the system's own.
prefs.notifGranted: Allowed. They appear when Ruchoir is not the window you are looking at.
prefs.notifDenied: Refused for this site. Only the browser can undo that: open the site information in the address bar, then allow notifications again.
prefs.notifUnsupported: This browser does not offer system notifications.
prefs.notifDefault: Ruchoir cannot tell you anything outside the tab until the browser allows it.
prefs.testBody: This is what a notification will look like.
prefs.notShownDesc: The browser accepted it, but the system did not show it. Check that notifications are allowed for your browser in the system settings, and that no focus or do-not-disturb mode is on.
prefs.fontSampleText: The quick brown fox jumps over the lazy dog.

error.nameTaken: That name is already taken in this space, or it cannot be used.
error.spaceNameUnusable: That space name cannot be used. Try another one.
error.invalidEmail: That address does not look valid.
error.noChannelRights: You do not have rights on this channel.
error.noSpaceRights: You do not have the rights on this space.

toast.inviteWrongAccount: This link does not match this account.
toast.inviteWaiting: Sign in, your invitation is waiting.
toast.dmFailed: Could not open the direct message
toast.ssoUnavailable: SSO is not configured on this instance.
toast.stillReadable: You can still read it, without notifications.
